We're trapped within a very very specific tight range, $11 and 80 cents up to the sell point here at $13. Just on the 15 minute chart let's back up and get a larger viewpoint of this asset right now i'm not horribly concerned we still do have a swooping pattern of higher lows being developed right here on chain link's price and one thing that i want to keep known within the chain link holders and anyone that's looking at this asset is during the boring times of crypto Chainlink is one of the most notorious accumulation Zone crypto projects on the planet we spent a total of about 525 days writhing edging ourselves back and forth between $5 and $8.80 for a very, very long time before we're able to move up to the local recent top, which really, in essence, hit about $30 at its peak in the last few years now. And with that movement, they're going to need communication between Web2 and Web3. And that is the roadway that Chainlink is built. So as I acknowledge all of the aggravation within this chart, but also see the force through the trees of what's being developed from these banks in the background, I feel like I'm on the right path with my Chainlink holdings. This is not a all ships rise with the tide scenario. This is institutions knocking on the door to institute web three technology into the current internet infrastructure. Or are you holding Chainlink and buying more into the dips as we move forward into the future? Because as I see it, communication, payments, everything that we know in our world has moved online.
